title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 27 (Variation in Terms of Contract or Objects in Prospectus)

content.overview: Section 27 restricts variation of a contract referred to in the prospectus or of the objects for which the prospectus stated the money was raised: variation requires a special resolution, prescribed publicity, and an exit offer to dissenting shareholders under SEBI-prescribed conditions.
content.glance: Special resolution; publicity; exit offer to dissenters.
content.study: A company cannot vary the terms of a contract referred to in the prospectus or the objects for which the prospectus stated that the money was proposed to be raised, except by special resolution. Prescribed disclosures must be published. Dissenting shareholders must be given an exit offer by the promoters or controlling shareholders at a price determined under SEBI regulations. Current-law framing: identify the prospectus representation; test whether variation followed the special-resolution and exit-offer route.

sections.heading: Restriction on Variation
sections.body: Prospectus-linked contract terms or objects cannot be varied except as provided in the section.

sections.heading: Special Resolution and Publicity
sections.body: Variation requires a special resolution and prescribed disclosures.

sections.heading: Exit Offer to Dissenters
sections.body: Dissenting shareholders must be offered an exit by promoters/controlling shareholders at a SEBI-determined price.

provisions.title: Variation in terms of contract or objects in prospectus

examples.title: Object variation with exit offer
examples.body: After a public issue, the company changes the objects stated in the prospectus via special resolution, publicity and an exit offer to dissenters.

examples.title: Variation without special resolution
examples.body: The board alone changes the use of IPO proceeds. Section 27 is breached.

hypotheticals.question: Can IPO objects be changed by ordinary resolution?
hypotheticals.analysis: No. Section 27 requires a special resolution and the statutory publicity and exit-offer process.

distinctions.title: Variation of prospectus objects (s. 27) vs alteration of memorandum objects (s. 13)

misconceptions.trap: Once money is raised, objects can be changed freely.
misconceptions.correction: Section 27 imposes special resolution, publicity and exit-offer requirements.

cases.name: Salomon v. A. Salomon & Co. Ltd.
cases.facts: Properly incorporated company challenged as indistinct from controller.
cases.ratioDecidendi: Registered company is a separate legal person.
